name: Lambda Persistence via Event Triggers
description: An attacker configures automated triggers so a backdoor Lambda function runs on a schedule or in response to events. Using events:PutRule and events:PutTargets, they create an EventBridge rule (e.g., rate(5 minutes)) that invokes the Lambda. Alternatively, lambda:CreateEventSourceMapping can attach S3, DynamoDB Streams, or other event sources. The Lambda executes periodically or on trigger without further attacker action. Required permissions include events:PutRule, events:PutTargets, and lambda:AddPermission (to allow EventBridge to invoke the Lambda).
mitigations: Restrict Lambda creation to specific roles
